svg.text: s2d_mpdda: pad input -> fully differential, voutp - voutn = 2 (vin - vref), (voutp + voutn)/2 = vcm
signal units A1 = A2 (vin, vref), F1 (vcm, vfbp), F2 (vfbn, vcm); CMFB units M1 (vfbp, vcm), M2 (vfbn, vcm); all unit_r2: x += f(gp - gn)
tie vfbp to voutp and vfbn to voutn; they are pins only so that the loops can be broken in simulation. CLP / CLN: built-in minimum load.
sinks SX / SY: 6 fingers of BN (6/6), SXC / SYC: 4 fingers; loads LP / LN mirror the CMFB diode D 1:1; netlist: ../../netlist/source/s2d_mpdda.spice
MDL 4 x 1u / 4u, D = S = B = vdd, G = vcmfb
(vcmfb is internal; the other dummies: s2d_mpdda_pd)
